title: Vacancy Details

fields.label: Short description
fields.name: summary
fields.instructions: One line under the job title.

fields.label: Details
fields.name: points
fields.instructions: One line each, as drawn in the design: role entails, experience needed, hours per week, starting rate.

fields.label: Apply at
fields.name: apply_url
fields.instructions: Link to the listing on Seek or another job board. When set, Apply Now opens this in a new tab and the email below is ignored.

fields.label: Apply to
fields.name: apply_email
fields.instructions: Used only when there is no link above. Leave empty for careers@tpph.com.au.

fields.label: Employment type
fields.name: employment_type
fields.instructions: Used by the JobPosting structured data so the role can appear in Google Jobs.

fields.label: Closing date
fields.name: closes
fields.instructions: Optional. Google requires a validThrough date or it treats the posting as stale after 30 days.

description: Cards on the Careers page. Order comes from the Order field under Page Attributes.
